name: Eve Aadams
source: Eve recently punched a careless guest in the face. She also recently earned herself a suspension and transfer. It wasn't always like this, though. Once an enthusiastic park ranger, eve has grown tired and cynical after being word down by ignorant visitors and bureaucracy. She's even begun wondering whether her job truly has any purpose, and if the land is ultimately worth protecting. Eve is dry and snarky, using her education and experience to cut down any optimism thrown her way. Yet underneath her rough exterior, she's still passionate about the parks.
